sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation expansion for original hand-drawn 2D dark fantasy insect game. Reference images are identity and style references only, NOT desired grid or background. Preserve exact character identity, proportions, costume, palette, clean ink and painterly material textures. Pure side view all living frames facing RIGHT. Transparent real alpha background, no backdrop, ground, shadows, labels, text, borders, particles, panels. Each equal cell contains exactly one COMPLETE character including every antenna, blade and robe, with ample transparent gutter. Fixed body scale and centered pelvis, grounded foot baseline at 90% cell height. Distinct redrawn poses with real limb and weapon articulation, never stamp, shift or rotate a whole copy. Character: Crimson Scissor Apostle exactly as refs, tall cockroach priest, wine-red ragged vestments, bronze needle crown, long antennae, ivory segmented abdomen and gigantic hinged sewing scissors held in both arms. Sheet exactly SIX columns by SIX rows 36 poses, square canvas. Character and COMPLETE open scissors must remain within only 78% cell width with transparent gutters. Read row-major indices 0-35: 0-3 idle breathing loop; 4-11 eight-frame alternating foot walk cycle with cloth/scissors counter-swing; 12-15 draw scissors upward and open blades to prepare; 16-21 six-frame forward scissors lunge and snapping closed with changing arm/torso angles; 22-27 withdraw blades/rebalance/recover to guard; 28-31 hurt recoil, bend and recover; 32-35 stumble/kneel/fall/full collapsed death. No weapon clipping or neighboring overlap. Distinct hand-drawn articulated poses, registered scale.

Do not copy original 4x3 layout; create 4x6 new poses on transparent background. No floor, no shadows, no text.

qa.review: Source sheets visually reviewed; independent complete alpha components explicitly selected; merged characters and edge-clipped poses excluded. Source atlas and attacks unchanged.
qa.mechanical_packaging: Component isolation of authored source pixels, scale normalization and atlas packing; no procedural animation or interpolation.
